title: Lampard 2009-10 v Bruno 2025-26: the best midfield season?
checked: Lampard: 22 league goals counted from the season page's match records (4 to 21 Nov, 18 from 29 Nov on), 16 assists top of the league (local file); Chelsea 103 league goals record, 86 points one ahead of United, 8-0 v Wigan on the final day, 1-0 FA Cup final win v Portsmouth with Lampard missing a penalty (Wikipedia season page; title and runner-up also local). Bruno: 9 league goals, 21 assists breaking the record of 20 held by Henry 2002-03 and De Bruyne 2019-20 (Wikipedia says he broke the record; local file has 21 and the old 20s), FWA award (both), United 3rd on 71 points, out of the League Cup on penalties at Grimsby and the FA Cup v Brighton (Wikipedia season page).

lines.text: One midfielder scored twenty-two. The other broke the assist record. Lampard or Bruno?
Frank Lampard, twenty oh nine, ten. A midfielder scoring like a striker.
Twenty-two league goals. Sixteen assists, the most in the league.
Bruno Fernandes, last season. Nine goals, and twenty-one assists.
That broke the record of twenty, shared by Thierry Henry and Kevin De Bruyne.
Goals plus assists: Lampard thirty-eight, Bruno thirty.
Trophies. Lampard won the league and the FA Cup. Chelsea scored a record hundred and three.
Bruno won the Football Writers' award. United finished third, and went out of the League Cup to Grimsby.
And here's the twist. The club Lampard beat to the title by one point? Manchester United.
Bruno's club, sixteen years earlier, beaten by Lampard's goals.

items.label: Chelsea pip United by a point

lines.text: Even Lampard's bad moment ended well. He missed a penalty in the cup final, and Chelsea still won one-nil.
Bruno has the record. Lampard has the better season. Settled.
